# FastSkill 0.9.230

Documentation for the current release only.

Release revision: dd983e89e5fee977325b77ae386b879e8310ed26
Documentation revision: dd983e89e5fee977325b77ae386b879e8310ed26

## Pages

- [Cheatsheet](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cheatsheet.md): Quick reference for common FastSkill operations
- [FastSkill](https://docs.gofastskill.com/index.md): Install, lock, bundle, discover, evaluate, and operate AI agent skills.
- [Install FastSkill](https://docs.gofastskill.com/installation.md): Install the current release on Linux, macOS, or Windows.
- [Install your first skill](https://docs.gofastskill.com/quickstart.md): Install a local skill, verify it, and make it available to an agent without an API key.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.gofastskill.com/troubleshooting.md): Diagnose and fix common FastSkill issues: lock files, embedding search, installs, and environment problems.
- [Understand FastSkill](https://docs.gofastskill.com/welcome.md): Skills, projects, locks, and bundles in one workflow.
- [Bundle commands](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/bundle-command.md): Build, install, update, restore, and customize self-contained team skill bundles.
- [cache Command](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/cache-command.md): Inspect and reclaim the on-disk skill content cache with fastskill cache.
- [Discover and inspect skills](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/discovery-commands.md): Find a catalog result, inspect its origin, and install it explicitly.
- [eval Command](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/eval-command.md): Validate, run, report, and score skill evaluation suites defined in skill-project.toml.
- [project init](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/init-command.md): 
- [project install](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/install-command.md): 
- [optimization commands](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/optimize-command.md): Run, resume, inspect, and export text-gradient skill optimization runs.
- [CLI Reference Overview](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/overview.md): The canonical FastSkill command tree for skills, bundles, projects, sources, quality, and operations.
- [index rebuild](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/reindex-command.md): Rebuild the local skill index for semantic search and analysis.
- [repo commands](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/repository-command.md): Manage skill repositories and browse the remote catalog with fastskill repo.
- [skill search](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/search-command.md): Search for skills using semantic embeddings or traditional keyword matching.
- [server serve](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/serve-command.md): 
- [Skill and project commands](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/skill-commands.md): Manage individual skills and restore projects through explicit skill and project namespaces.
- [Marketplace, analysis, and CLI tools](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/tooling-commands.md): CLI reference for fastskill marketplace, fastskill analysis, and fastskill cli doctor.
- [skill update](https://docs.gofastskill.com/cli-reference/update-command.md): 
- [Init Command](https://docs.gofastskill.com/configuration/init-command.md): Create skill-project.toml for skill authors and project configuration.
- [Advanced Patterns](https://docs.gofastskill.com/examples/advanced-patterns.md): Analyze overlap, optimize skills, filter project groups, and manage editable and global skills.
- [Integration Tutorials](https://docs.gofastskill.com/examples/integration-tutorials.md): Connect FastSkill to agents and pipelines: MCP into Claude Code and Cursor, the serve HTTP API, and locked installs in CI.
- [Cluster and Portfolio Analysis](https://docs.gofastskill.com/evals-quality/cluster-analysis.md): Analyze skill quality at portfolio level using cluster, matrix, and duplicate detection.
- [Evals and Quality Overview](https://docs.gofastskill.com/evals-quality/overview.md): How FastSkill quality workflows fit together: validate, run evals, score, and cluster analysis.
- [Run Evals](https://docs.gofastskill.com/evals-quality/run-evals.md): Operational guide for running, reporting, and scoring FastSkill eval suites.
- [Eval Setup](https://docs.gofastskill.com/evals-quality/setup.md): Author an eval suite: the [tool.fastskill.eval] manifest table, the prompts CSV, and the checks TOML schema.
- [Documentation and tools for agents](https://docs.gofastskill.com/integration/agents.md): Retrieve current FastSkill documentation as Markdown and use the CLI or MCP safely.
- [Claude Code Integration](https://docs.gofastskill.com/integration/claude-code-integration.md): Integrate FastSkill with Claude Code for intelligent skill discovery.
- [Cursor Integration](https://docs.gofastskill.com/integration/cursor-integration.md): Integrate FastSkill with Cursor IDE for intelligent skill discovery and tool recommendations.
- [Configuration Reference](https://docs.gofastskill.com/optimize/configuration.md): All fields in optimize.toml, with valid ranges, defaults, and guidance on choosing values.
- [Skill Optimization Overview](https://docs.gofastskill.com/optimize/overview.md): Use text-gradient optimization to automatically improve skill documents by iterating on eval feedback.
- [Inspecting and Exporting Results](https://docs.gofastskill.com/optimize/results.md): Drill into step artifacts to understand what changed, and export the best skill document.
- [Running and Monitoring](https://docs.gofastskill.com/optimize/running.md): Start an optimization run, watch it progress, and resume after interruption.
- [Setup: Eval Data and Grading](https://docs.gofastskill.com/optimize/setup.md): Prepare the suite CSV and checks TOML that drive skill optimization.
- [Context Resolution API](https://docs.gofastskill.com/progressive-loading/performance.md): How agents get the most relevant skills for a prompt via `POST /api/v1/resolve`, and the embedding index that powers ranking.
- [Loading Strategies](https://docs.gofastskill.com/progressive-loading/strategies.md): Configure embeddings, decide when to rebuild the index, and search installed skills.
- [Registry Index System](https://docs.gofastskill.com/registry/index-system.md): Understanding the on-disk registry index format read by fastskill server serve and registry search
- [Marketplace.json Format](https://docs.gofastskill.com/registry/marketplace-json.md): 
- [Sources and catalogs](https://docs.gofastskill.com/registry/overview.md): Discover skills from configured sources and choose how to distribute a team setup.
- [Choose a distribution model](https://docs.gofastskill.com/registry/repository-architecture.md): Decide between direct sources, catalogs, and self-contained team bundles.
- [Configure skill sources](https://docs.gofastskill.com/registry/sources.md): Add skills from Git and configure local, Git marketplace, HTTP, and ZIP catalogs.
- [Local browser console](https://docs.gofastskill.com/registry/web-ui.md): Inspect installed skills and manage a project through the optional HTTP server.
- [Security Best Practices](https://docs.gofastskill.com/security/best-practices.md): Operational guidance for running FastSkill safely: read-only serve, auth proxies, PAT env-var indirection, and locked CI installs.
- [Security Model](https://docs.gofastskill.com/security/model.md): How FastSkill treats trust boundaries: read-only-by-default serve, no in-app auth, env-var token indirection, and reproducible locked installs.
- [Manifests, locks, and scope](https://docs.gofastskill.com/skill-management/manifest-system.md): Declare sources and understand what FastSkill restores for a project or user.
- [Skill Reconciliation System](https://docs.gofastskill.com/skill-management/reconciliation.md): Understanding how FastSkill reconciles installed skills with project manifests and lockfiles.
- [Validate a skill](https://docs.gofastskill.com/skill-management/validation.md): Check skill structure and installed state before an agent uses it.
- [Debugging Guide](https://docs.gofastskill.com/testing/debugging.md): Diagnose FastSkill setup and behavior with `fastskill cli doctor` and `--verbose` output.
- [Testing Framework](https://docs.gofastskill.com/testing/framework.md): Test your skills with `fastskill eval` — validate configuration, run prompts against an agent, and score the results.
- [MCP Tool Calling](https://docs.gofastskill.com/tool-calling/development.md): Expose FastSkill to agents as MCP tools with `fastskill mcp serve` (read-only by default, `--enable-write` to allow mutation), and wire them into Claude Code, Cursor, and other agents with `fastskill mcp install`.
